text:
marco_sales: Quick thread for the Polaris renewal (3w out). Customer wants to: split the annual commit into 2 tranches, shift 25% of Year1 to a midterm tranche, and get a $95,000 goodwill credit for the downtime in Q4. Need deal desk signoff + security/finance checks. cc @dina_dealdesk @fareed_security

dina_dealdesk: Please paste the exact numbers and the proposed ratecard. Reminder: discounts >15% require VP approval, credits >$50k need director signoff. Provide incident reference for the goodwill ask.

marco_sales: Numbers below (proposed):
- List price year1: $380,000
- Requested split: Tranche1 (60%) = $228,000, Tranche2 (40%) = $152,000
- Goodwill credit: $95,000 applied to Tranche1 invoice
- Net Tranche1 invoice: $133,000
Ratecard variant: enterprise-std-2026, with a 10% committed discount baseline.

fareed_security: Security checklist: they want BYOK KMS + SP-initiated SAML. Need SOC2 Type II, SAML metadata, KMS key policy sample, and a short dataflow (logs -> logging account). Any external PCI/PHI?

marco_sales: No PCI/PHI, only emails & user ids. I'll upload the incident summary and the support ticket link: https://redwood.app/tickets/PL-9981

lisa_finance: Accounting note: credits can be applied as negative line items if amendment signed within 120 days. Use GL code RED-ADJ-02 for goodwill. We need the signed amendment before we process. Also confirm billing cadence if splitting midterm (will it be two invoices or pro-rated monthly?).

tariq_infra: POC detail: they ran load on Redwood Dedicated (8xV100). To keep latency targets for Tranche1, recommend reserving capacity for first 8 weeks and enable prefix caching warmup. That will have a token burn estimated ~1.2M tokens for priming. Add that to the cost model.

nina_csm: Customer asks for a 15-day SLA credit window for missed p95 latency during Tranche1. They want an objective metric (p95 > 500ms) and an auto-remediation plan. Can we propose language?

marco_sales: Draft amendment plan: split commit into two invoices, list credit line as negative item on invoice 1, SLA language: up to 5% monthly credit if p95 exceeds 500ms for more than 3 days in the month (cap $10k/month). Will draft formally.

dina_dealdesk: That cap looks reasonable. Because the credit is ~25% of list price, I'm flagging for director approval. /dealdesk request 1767777777 --type credit --amount 95000 --approver sara_legal

dealdesk-bot: DealDesk ticket DD-4971 opened for request 1767777777 by dina_dealdesk. Status: awaiting documentation.

sara_legal: I'll review the amendment template. We should include a "one-time concession" clause and a non-precedent language. Also include rollback language if they terminate early.

fareed_security: Send SAML metadata + KMS ARNs and a quick dataflow diagram to me. I'll run the QA and attach a short risk memo. Use template: https://redwood.app/sec/templates/dataflow-v2

lisa_finance: For invoicing preference: customer prefers two invoices (Tranche1 upfront, Tranche2 at H2). Finance needs the signed amendment + DocuSign envelope id to book the credit.

tariq_infra: Please confirm which GPU SKU to reserve: they used V100 but asked about A100s for next-gen perf. If they want A100s we need capacity lead time. @infra-scheduling

nina_csm: I'll get the customer to produce SAML metadata and confirm SLA wording by EOD tomorrow. Also will ask them to accept the split and the non-repeat credit clause.

marco_sales: Timeline ask: can deal desk sign off by Thursday so Legal can finish amendment + DocuSign before renewal? If not, we risk losing the renewal.

dina_dealdesk: I'll prioritize DD-4971 but need incident summary + comms doc attached. If VP signoff required I'll ping emma_vp_sales.

sara_legal: If everything else is in order I'll approve the amendment language. Send me the drafted text in this thread when ready.

fareed_security: Once they share metadata I'll aim to clear within 48 hours. If BYOK key policies look non-standard we may need a short MSA addendum.

marco_sales: Uploading incident summary + draft amendment now: https://redwood.app/docs/renewals/polaris-amend-v1 (will update with DocuSign link). Thanks all. :v:
